svg.title: The evidence van reaches Municipal Hall after the utility crew has entered.
svg.desc: Babul-da brakes the cycle van at the Hall steps while Riju grabs for the waterproof tube. Deep in the corridor, the utility crew is already approaching the server cupboard with its order device.
